        return "number"

        return "datetime"
    elif lib.is_np_dtype(x, "m"):
        return "duration"
    elif isinstance(x, ExtensionDtype) and x.name == "Categorical":
        return "any"
    elif is_string_dtype(x) or isinstance(x, pd.StringDtype):
        return "string"
    else:
        return "any"
